Northline Technologies

Job Title: Digital Campaign Marketing Student
Company: Northline Technologies
Location: Ottawa, ON
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Fall 2026
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $24.50 - $28.00 per hour
Application Deadline: July 17, 2026

About the Role
Northline Technologies is looking for a Digital Campaign Marketing Student to join our
demand generation team for the upcoming work term. You will support marketing operations
across email, paid social, and web channels.

Responsibilities
- Build and QA campaigns in our marketing automation platform
- Maintain campaign calendars and reporting dashboards
- Support marketing analytics reporting for quarterly business reviews

Qualifications
- Enrolled in a post-secondary program in marketing, business, or communications
- Familiarity with Marketo or a comparable marketing automation tool is an asset

This role follows a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office.
